observations: Large marine diesel engine on a pallet.
Exterior shows significant rust, dirt, and wear.
Red fuel tank and red oil filters are attached.
Blue alternator is mounted on the side.
Exhaust pipe and intake manifold are visible.
No manufacturer's identification plate is visible in any photo.
Watermark 'DNL EQUIPMENT SALES AND' appears on all photos.

claims.evidence: No Cat logo or 3208 model number is visible on the engine in any photo.
Photo 0 shows a complete engine assembly.
The engine is shown assembled, but internal components and the crankshaft are not visible.
The size and configuration are consistent with a marine diesel engine.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or may have internal mechanical failure.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running and a compression test report.

risks.risk: Crankshaft may be seized or damaged.
risks.proof: Video of the engine turning over by hand or with a starter.

risks.risk: Exhaust system or turbocharger may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: Photo of the exhaust manifold and turbocharger assembly.

risks.risk: Fuel and oil systems may be clogged or leaking.
risks.proof: Video of the fuel system priming and the oil system circulating.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate.
Photo of the crankshaft and flywheel.
Photo of the exhaust system and turbocharger.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
